body.x: The Daegu Technopark (Daegu TP) Sports Convergence Industrial Support Center will be exhibiting at CES 2019 (The), the world's largest IT appliance exhibition in Las Vegas, USA from January 8 (Tue) to 11 (Fri), and operate booths for 14 companies related to sports convergence technology.

Daegu TPSports Convergence Industrial Support Center, established in May 2015 with thesupport of Ministry of Culture, Sports, and Tourism & Daegu City to promotemajor sports industry zone within Daegu and Gyeongbuk province, participatedfor 3 consecutive years and operated Sports and Fitness Tech Zone.

In addition to exhibiting technology and demonstrating the products, they will also provide export consultations with related buyers in the US and around the world. Related to sports ICT convergence technology, ▲ Funkey Co., Ltd. exhibits 'BIG9', an APP-related exercise equipment for children, to prevent childhood diseases and various diseases, which can be enjoyed easily anytime and anywhere. ▲ Inthe Hands presents ‘TrainingMate,’ a smart posture correction device for safe and efficient muscle training.

▲ ENERCAMP plansto show a large capacity smart battery and smart IoT power station that can beused in camping and everyday life. ▲ Myung Sung shows 'SMODO106' which is a bluetoothspeaker on camping torch and also fan with a honeycomb net design. This fan is6 inches in size and lightweight, and can be used wirelessly indoors andoutdoors.

The Daegu TP Sports Convergence Industrial Support Center also organizes exhibitions in the U-Health field as the interest in health in aging society increases. ▲ Inthe Tech is preparing to exhibit 'EYAS', an IT-based attention-enhancing product for preventing, restoring and strengthening the attentional deterioration of cognitive decline groups. ▲ HUWANT will introduce 'BREATHE-ON', a healthcare product using expiration and inspiration. This product has an advantage that it can perform healthy respiration training and exercise by linking smart device and dedicated APP.

▲ YH Life ispreparing for a foot stretch product 'Cool Fin' to help blood circulation and also‘Balae,’ a toe correction device. ▲ One Softdigm will show ONE SMARTDIET, aportable body composition measuring device. Fitrus +, a handheld device withcloud-based healthcare services that can measure heart rate and temperature aswell as body composition, is also on the way. ▲ Seyoung Information &Telecommunication's portable, two-way radio transceiver 'WiWi' is going toachieve substantial achievement for three consecutive years. ▲ Show IndoorSports plans to exhibit a cycle VR simulator and contents that can be enjoyedthrough actual physical activity . Also, they will introduce integrated modulefor various simulator production, so foreign buyers are expected to have muchinterest and consultation.

In addition, the Daegu TP Sports Convergence Industrial Support Center also provides space for experiencing and demonstrating products developed beyond simple exhibition. ▲ Daeryu Co., Ltd. will exhibit 'Curomi', a portable low-frequency treatment device that is portable and easy to move, and provide a space for visitors to experience. ▲ TTNG is planning to show HelloCaddy, an intelligent robot cart that can act as a caddy along the golf course. ▲ The ZEST baseball automatic tie-up machine, which is spurring overseas expansion projects, will be reborn as a real-time baseball simulator called "Perfection", which is a fusion of game development technology and sensor technology of Quantum Games.

In particular, Daegu TP Sports Convergence Industrial Support Center will conduct a demonstration to promote participating companies and products twice a day during the exhibition so that 14 companies participating in the PR center can receive the attention of visitors and foreign buyers. Lee Jae-hoon, managing director of the Las Vegas CES 2019 Sports Complex Multi-Purpose Promotion Center, said, "We would like to open up the possibilities for local companies to enter the global market through the creation of this promotional center," “We will not spare any kind of support for local IT companies to enter the global market. "
